text: Call Issued: June 11, 2018 Call Closed: July 9, 2018 Number of Addenda Issued: Four (4) Number of Bids: Two (2) Proponent Name Morrison Hershfield Limited Parsons Inc. All proposals met the 75 percent technical threshold score and had their cost of services opened and evaluated.
